The hovered primary action uses --as-accent-hover, a role measured against the label it carries. It used to use the line colour, which is proven at 3:1 as a line and took the white label to 4.35:1 — a resting state that passes proves nothing about the state a pointer is actually in, and both harnesses now measure all three.
